caption: The drawing shows a single piece of furniture, specifically an ornate sofa with a high, curved backrest and gently outward-flaring armrests. The upper portion of the image is a colored illustration depicting the sofa upholstered in a light pink fabric with a crisscross diamond pattern, and the frame is rendered in a brown, wood-like color with carved decorative details in the center of the backrest and along the lower front panel. The sofa stands on four curved legs, each with additional carved accents. The lower portion of the image contains two black and white technical drawings of the sofa: one front view and one side view, both annotated with various dimensional measurements. The technical drawings outline the same curved shapes and carved decorations as the colored illustration above and specify dimensions in inches for different parts of the sofa’s structure. The background of the drawing is cream or off-white in color.
title: Sofa
